title: Signed-payload strkey with a 64-byte inner payload, the longest valid strkey of any type (165 characters)
why: XDR allows up to 64 payload bytes, so a P address can reach 165 characters, the widest address a reader meets; fixed-width text or binary columns truncate it.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.signed-payload-64-byte.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Executed in every probe column as vector 9S5 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json).
